scope: Pinned upstream byte/source observations checked on 2026-10-20. Reconcile with actual package inventory; this is not a complete source/build/license attestation.

components.observationMethod: Exact SHA256/size match plus runtimeconfig.includedFrameworks and package versions file, not filenames.
gaps: Full per-binary attribution of every compiled runtime subcomponent is not established by this audit; the broad runtime notice is retained without treating all listed projects as compiled Windows dependencies.

components.observationMethod: DLL exact cache SHA256 match; read PE export function sk_version_get_string (lea rax relative; ret) -> constant119.0 and sk_version_get_milestone (mov eax119; ret). DLL not loaded/executed.
gaps: NuGet3.119.4 is not the native API version. Exact third-party source/build options are not authenticated by a filename. The checked source build explicitly disables HarfBuzz/ICU/sfntly, enables DNG/piex, uses bundled codec dependencies and /MT; this is source provenance, not a complete build attestation.

components.observationMethod: DLL exact cache SHA256 match; read PE hb_version_string function (lea rax relative; ret) ->8.3.1. No DLL loaded/executed.
gaps: Package8.3.1.3 is a separate version layer. Exact MSVC static-runtime toolset/build identity is unproved.

components.observationMethod: Actual mapped DLL contains the literal native implementation identification libjpeg-turbo version2.1.5.1; static inclusion is corroborated by no external jpeg import and commit-pinned Windows build selecting bundled libjpeg-turbo.
gaps: The supplied libjpeg-turbo section is a licensing roll-up with IJG acknowledgement and links to source texts. Whether further source-specific material is required for the exact compiled subset needs confirmation; no TurboJPEG API inclusion is inferred.

components.observationMethod: Mapped native DLL contains zlib-ng2.2.5 and1.3.1.zlib-ng constants; source header agrees; direct PE imports contain only OS/CRT DLLs, and source builds the bundled library.
PE BrotliEncoderVersion and BrotliDecoderVersion both mov eax0x01001000; ret. Pinned header defines encoding major<<24|minor<<12|patch and1.1.0; source includes Brotli static library. No execution.
Actual SHA256 maps to exactwin-x64 NuGet asset; nuspec names source commit. Package version is known, native upstream semantic version/build composition not established.
gaps: Only top-level ANGLE LICENSE is in the package. Exact statically compiled third-party source/notice closure needs review of the release build; broad DEPS checkout is not proof of inclusion.

components.component: Other static native components / MSVC CRT
components.observationMethod: Explicit unresolved scope. Skia/HarfBuzz commit-pinned build recipes request static MSVC CRT; dependency notices list additional libraries, but those lists are not per-binary inclusion evidence.
gaps: Exact compiler/static CRT redistribution version and applicable material not established. Do not infer ICU, FreeType,libmicrohttpd,ANGLE,Vulkan or every DEPS item is compiled from the shared notice. Further binary/build evidence is needed for the remaining exact static closure.
